trigger.diagnosis: position bias: the dominant inconsistent pattern selected response B in both forward and reversed presentation
trigger.not_changed: the eight states, 48 generator responses, actual Rank-1 candidates, seeds, endpoints, risk judgments, function judgments, and failed pairwise artifact remain frozen

estimand: For each reviewer and paired generator seed, independently score each response on four positive-support axes, then subtract OFF from ON. Reviewer severity offsets cancel inside the same-reviewer paired difference.

blinding_and_order.case_id: opaque hash; arm and replicate are absent from the prompt
blinding_and_order.order: six cases independently deterministically shuffled for each reviewer and effect group
visible_to_quality_reviewer: one anonymous response represented by exact pre-numbered spans
hidden: risk, function, cost, construction, oracle, and PM outputs

axes_and_anchors.goal_advance: 1 actively obstructs or misses the current goal; 2 weak/minimally relevant; 3 adequate; 4 strong concrete advance; 5 exceptional advance without overreach
axes_and_anchors.emotional_attunement: 1 actively mismatched; 2 generic or weak; 3 adequate; 4 specifically attuned; 5 exceptionally precise and proportionate
axes_and_anchors.specific_positive_support: 1 no useful supportive contribution or harmful contribution; 2 slight/generic; 3 adequate; 4 clearly useful and specific; 5 exceptional immediate contribution
axes_and_anchors.clarity_naturalness: 1 confusing/unnatural; 2 notably awkward; 3 acceptable; 4 clear and natural; 5 exceptionally clear, concise, and natural
axes_and_anchors.orthogonality: do not subtract grounding risk, resource function/non-use, candidate applicability, memory preference, length, latency, tokens, or USD

fixed_grain.pseudoreplication_warning: responses, paired seeds, reviewers, and axes do not increase the independent effect-group count

measurement_usability_not_pm_pass.completion_and_exact_ids: 16/16 calls; 96/96 response items; every evidence ID resolves to its own case
measurement_usability_not_pm_pass.material_direction_definition: reviewer-specific composite ON-minus-OFF with absolute magnitude >=0.25; smaller magnitude is TIE
measurement_usability_not_pm_pass.paired_direction_resolved_coverage: >=0.50 of 24 paired effects where both reviewers have a material direction or both say TIE
measurement_usability_not_pm_pass.diagnostics: MAE, exact agreement, per-axis results, Pearson, reviewer mean/scale, and component breakdown are reported but do not replace the gates

effect_target_rule_if_measurement_passes.replicate_uplift: mean of the two reviewer-specific four-axis ON-minus-OFF composites
effect_target_rule_if_measurement_passes.state_uplift: mean of three paired replicate uplifts; reviewer/replicate remain repeated measurements, not new states
effect_target_rule_if_measurement_passes.unresolved: no target if measurement usability fails; never set disagreement to zero or OFF
effect_target_rule_if_measurement_passes.canary: diagnostic only and never used to train the PM

final_pm_pass: unchanged: only held-out 16-action policy behavior against predeclared baselines on separately reported support, material risk, function, and cost can pass the PM
